title: SCOTT PARKER'S FIRST GAME AT WEST HAM: 3-0 DOWN, THEN 3-3
description:
One day in the job. Three goals down at half-time. Welcome to West Ham, Scott.

Cardiff's Jack Moylan scored a hat-trick before the 39th minute. Three goals, no win. Harsh. Then Parker made his half-time changes, and the second half did the rest. Divine Mukasa pulled one back. Arne Engels scored his first West Ham goal. Max Kilman headed in a Bowen cross, and it finished three-all.

West Ham were relegated last season. Now they sit eighth, which is the final play-off place. Parker is unbeaten as West Ham boss. Sample size: one game.

So who's happier with 3-3, West Ham or Cardiff? Make your case in the comments.
